Text_en: The violent treatment of the protests of the Baloch people in the city of Quetta, Pakistan, which led to the death and injury of several people and the arrest of the leaders of the protestors, is very painful and worrying. The government of Pakistan should listen to the voices of the protesters and respond to their legal and humanitarian demands through dialogue by releasing the detainees.

We expect the government and the president to give "special attention" to the province of Sistan-Baluchistan and the coastal areas/ the people of the province should be seen in the big plans.

Text_en: The country is facing severe and unprecedented crises. If the authorities do not have the necessary motivation to solve the problems and cope with the world powers, it is smart to get along with the Iranian nation and submit to their will to prevent social collapse.
